name: Dust II
notes: Bomb sites and spawn zones: CS2's awpy-data nav has no place names and map_data.json has no entities, so these are measured by tools/build-map.ts's method in docs/maps.md ('Map facts').

rects: the CS2 radar's own outlines (radars/de_dust2.png of awpy-data 2000942: orange = bomb site, green = spawn zone), found as colour components and converted with the map_data transform (pos_x -2476, pos_y 3239, scale 4.4).

planter: the 'CanBePlanter' spawns of B3none/cs2-retakes RetakesPlugin/map_config/de_dust2.json (commit 2fde4a9cc21e791d6909b98bacc833aa5c54bdad, GPL-3.0; coordinates only), team 2 (T), Bombsite 0 = A, 1 = B. Every one lies inside its radar outline.
